caption: The drawing depicts a single metal teapot rendered in shades of gray and black. The teapot has a tall, conical lid topped with a small decorative knob. The body is bulbous and tapers towards the top, with a long, narrow spout extending out from the left side and a wide, curved handle attached to the right. The surface of the teapot is adorned with ornate decorative patterns, including floral and vine motifs along the base and a detailed depiction of a bird on the main body. The entire drawing is set against a plain, light-colored background, emphasizing the form and decoration of the teapot. The artist’s signature, “Frances Lichten,” appears near the lower right of the teapot’s base.
title: Pa. German Coffee Pot
